statement: Generated, never hand-edited. Every block, element, variant, state and token below is read from src/css by the same inventory that publishes every count in this repository, and tools/check-components.mjs fails if the shipped bytes are not that derivation. `tokens` lists the custom properties a block's rules read; a rule naming two blocks (`.c-alert, .c-callout`) is credited to both, because that is what a retune does.
